SELECT A.COL1 AS "VALUE_COL" , A.COL2 AS "TEXT_COL" FROM( SELECT 'key1' AS COL1, 'Option1' AS COL2, 'type1' AS TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 'key2' AS COL1, 'Option2' AS COL2, 'type2' AS TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 'key3' AS COL1, 'Option3' AS COL2, 'type3' AS TYPE UNION ALL SELECT 'key4' AS COL1, 'Option4' AS COL2, 'type4' AS TYPE ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.COL2 != #{TYPE}

SELECT A.COL1 AS "VALUE_COL" , A.COL2 AS "TEXT_COL" FROM( SELECT '' AS COL1, 'ALL' AS COL2 UNION ALL SELECT 'TYPE1' AS COL1, 'TYPE1' AS COL2 UNION ALL SELECT 'TYPE2' AS COL1, 'TYPE2' AS COL2 UNION ALL SELECT 'TYPE3' AS COL1, 'TYPE3' AS COL2 ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.COL2 != #{TYPE}

WITH RECURSIVE MENU AS( SELECT COMPID , MENUGID , MENUID , PMENUID , SORTORDER , 1 AS LV , CAST(SORTORDER AS VARCHAR) AS SORTTXT FROM MSTMENUGL WHERE COMPID = #{COMPID} AND MENUGID = 'PDA' AND PMENUID = 'root' UNION ALL SELECT A.COMPID , A.MENUGID , A.MENUID , A.PMENUID , A.SORTORDER , MENU.LV + 1 AS LV , MENU.SORTTXT || '_' ||A.SORTORDER AS SORTTXT FROM MENU INNER JOIN MSTMENUGL A ON MENU.MENUID = A.PMENUID WHERE A.COMPID = #{COMPID} AND A.MENUGID = 'PDA' ) SELECT M.MENUGID AS "MENUGID" , M.MENUID AS "MENUID" , M.PMENUID AS "AMNUID" , P.MENUNAME AS "LBLTXL" , P.URI AS "PGPATH" , P.IMGPTH AS "IMGPTH" , P.MENUTYPE AS "MNUTYP" FROM MENU M LEFT OUTER JOIN MSTMENU P ON P.MENUID = M.MENUID AND P.COMPID = 'WDSCM' LEFT OUTER JOIN SYSLABEL L ON L.LABELGID = 'MENU' AND L.LANGCODE = 'KO' AND P.MENULABEL = L.LABELID ORDER BY M.SORTTXT

WITH RECURSIVE MENU AS( SELECT COMPID , MENUGID , MENUID , PMENUID , SORTORDER , 1 AS LV , CAST(SORTORDER AS VARCHAR) AS SORTTXT FROM MSTMENUGL WHERE COMPID = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND MENUGID = 'PDA' AND PMENUID = 'root' UNION ALL SELECT A.COMPID , A.MENUGID , A.MENUID , A.PMENUID , A.SORTORDER , MENU.LV + 1 AS LV , MENU.SORTTXT || '_' ||A.SORTORDER AS SORTTXT FROM MENU INNER JOIN MSTMENUGL A ON MENU.MENUID = A.PMENUID WHERE A.COMPID = #{COMPID} AND A.MENUGID = 'PDA' ) SELECT M.MENUGID AS "MENUGID" , M.MENUID AS "MENUID" , M.PMENUID AS "AMNUID" , P.MENUNAME AS "LBLTXL" , '' AS "PGPATH" , P.IMGPTH AS "IMGPTH" , M.MENUID AS "PROGID" FROM MENU M LEFT OUTER JOIN MSTMENU P ON P.MENUID = M.MENUID AND P.COMPID = 'WDSCM' LEFT OUTER JOIN SYSLABEL L ON L.LABELGID = 'MENU' AND L.LANGCODE = 'KO' AND P.MENULABEL = L.LABELID WHERE P.MENUTYPE = 'F' ORDER BY M.SORTTXT DESC

SELECT A.ASNTTY AS "ASNTTY" , C.SHORTX AS "ASNTNM" , A.ASNDKY AS "ASNDKY" , A.DOCDAT AS "DOCDAT" , CASE WHEN A.ASNTTY = '003' THEN A.DEPTID3 ELSE A.DPTNKY END AS "PTNRKY" , CASE WHEN A.ASNTTY = '003' THEN A.DNAME3 ELSE A.DNAME1 END AS "PTNRNM" , A.USRID1 AS "SEBELN" FROM ASNDH A INNER JOIN DOCTM B ON A.ASNTTY = B.DOCUTY INNER JOIN DOCTM C ON B.CDOCTY = C.DOCUTY WHERE A.COMPKY = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND A.STATDO IN('NEW', 'PPC') AND A.INDDCL != 'V' ORDER BY A.ASNDKY

SELECT A.ASNDKY AS "ASNDKY" , A.COMPKY AS "COMPKY" , A.WAREKY AS "WAREKY" , A.OWNRKY AS "OWNRKY" , A.ASNTTY AS "ASNTTY" , B.DOCGRP AS "DOCCAT" , B.CDOCTY AS "RCPTTY" , A.STATDO AS "STATDO" , A.DOCDAT AS "DOCDAT"
, A.DEPTID3 AS "DEPTID3" , A.DNAME3 AS "DNAME3"
, A.DPTNKY AS "DPTNKY" , A.DNAME1 AS "DNAME1"
, A.USRID1 AS "SEBELN" , A.USRID2 AS "SVBELN" , A.UNAME1 AS "SZMBLNO" FROM ASNDH A INNER JOIN DOCTM B ON A.ASNTTY = B.DOCUTY INNER JOIN DOCTM C ON B.CDOCTY = C.DOCUTY WHERE A.COMPKY = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND A.ASNDKY = #{ASNDKY} AND A.STATDO IN('NEW', 'PPC') LIMIT 1
SELECT TASKKY AS "TASKKY" , DOCDAT AS "DOCDAT" FROM TASDH WHERE COMPKY = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND TASOTY = '301' AND STATDO IN('NEW', 'PPC') ORDER BY DOCDAT

SELECT DISTINCT S.SHPOKY AS "SHPOKY" , S.RQSHPD AS "RQSHPD" , S.DPTNKY AS "PTNRKY" , S.DNAME1 AS "PTNRNM" , S.PTRCVR AS "PTRCVR" , S.DNAME2 AS "PTRCNM" FROM TASDH H INNER JOIN TASDI I ON H.COMPKY = I.COMPKY AND H.TASKKY = I.TASKKY AND I.STATIT != 'CLS' INNER JOIN SHPDH S ON I.COMPKY = S.COMPKY AND I.SHPOKY = S.SHPOKY WHERE H.COMPKY = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND S.SHPMTY = '201' AND I.TASKTY = 'PK' AND I.STATIT IN('NEW', 'PPC') ORDER BY S.SHPOKY ASC

SELECT A.SVBELN AS "SVBELN" , A.SPOSNR AS "SPOSNR" , CASE WHEN SHPOKY = '' THEN 'WAVE 생성 전' WHEN QTALOC = 0 THEN '미작업' WHEN QTALOC > 0 AND (QTYORD - QTALOC) = 0 AND QTJCMP = 0 AND QTSHPD = 0 THEN '할당완료' WHEN QTALOC > 0 AND (QTYORD - QTALOC) > 0 AND QTJCMP = 0 AND QTSHPD = 0 THEN '부분할당' WHEN (QTALOC > 0 AND QTJCMP > 0) AND (QTYORD - QTJCMP) = 0 AND QTSHPD = 0 THEN '피킹완료' WHEN (QTALOC > 0 AND QTJCMP > 0) AND (QTYORD - QTJCMP) > 0 AND QTSHPD = 0 THEN '부분피킹' WHEN (QTALOC > 0 AND QTJCMP > 0 AND QTSHPD > 0) AND (QTYORD - QTSHPD) = 0 THEN '출고완료' WHEN (QTALOC > 0 AND QTJCMP > 0 AND QTSHPD > 0) AND (QTYORD - QTSHPD) > 0 THEN '부분출고' END AS "STATDO" , A.RQSHPD AS "RQSHPD" , A.PTNRKY AS "PTNRKY" , A.PTNRNM AS "PTNRNM" , A.PTRCVR AS "PTRCVR" , A.PTRCNM AS "PTRCNM" , A.SKUKEY AS "SKUKEY" , A.DESC01 AS "DESC01" , A.QTYORD AS "QTYORD" , A.QTALOC AS "QTALOC" , A.QTJCMP AS "QTJCMP" , A.QTSHPD AS "QTSHPD" , A.SHPOKY AS "SHPOKY" , A.SHPOIT AS "SHPOIT" FROM( SELECT A.SVBELN , A.SPOSNR , A.RQSHPD , A.PTNRKY , A.PTNRNM , A.PTRCVR , A.PTRCNM , A.SKUKEY , A.DESC01 , A.QTYORD :: INT , COALESCE(B.QTALOC :: INT, 0) AS QTALOC , COALESCE(B.QTJCMP :: INT, 0) AS QTJCMP , COALESCE(B.QTSHPD :: INT, 0) AS QTSHPD , COALESCE(B.SHPOKY,'') AS SHPOKY , COALESCE(B.SHPOIT,'') AS SHPOIT FROM IFSHP A LEFT OUTER JOIN SHPDI B ON A.COMPKY = B.COMPKY AND A.SVBELN = B.SVBELN AND A.SPOSNR = B.SPOSNR WHERE A.COMPKY = #{SES_USER_COMPANY} AND A.SVBELN = #{SVBELN} AND A.RQSHPD = #{RQSHPD} AND A.PTNRKY = #{PTNRKY} AND A.PTRCVR = #{PTRCVR} AND B.SHPOKY = #{SHPOKY} ) A ORDER BY A.SVBELN, A.SPOSNR

SELECT A.VALUE_COL AS "VALUE_COL" , A.TEXT_COL AS "TEXT_COL" FROM( SELECT '' AS VALUE_COL, '전체' AS TEXT_COL UNION ALL SELECT '01' AS VALUE_COL, 'Wave' AS TEXT_COL UNION ALL SELECT '02' AS VALUE_COL, '미작업' AS TEXT_COL UNION ALL SELECT '03' AS VALUE_COL, '할당' AS TEXT_COL UNION ALL SELECT '04' AS VALUE_COL, '피킹' AS TEXT_COL UNION ALL SELECT '05' AS VALUE_COL, '출고' AS TEXT_COL ) A
